evidence.reason: The test replaces every received pending title with the expected title at line 333 before reserializing and comparing bytes at line 339. A wrong cached or fetched title is therefore overwritten and cannot fail the test; line 347 only checks the gh call log. The comment at lines 316-320 documents the fixture workaround, but that is a test-harness limitation, not a reason to mutate actual output before comparison. The gh stub should supply the expected/recorded title and the unmodified publishSummary output should be compared.
